official_design_note: Private scoring anchors for hidden cases. Batch7 stores no direct official design vector in expected.json; the oracle derives its output by evaluating candidates through compute_score.py.
oracle_policy_note: Ground-truth uses the same normal continuous scoring path as every other valid submission. No digest shortcut is used.
fallback_policy_note: If blockMesh or simpleFoam fails, analytic response metrics may provide capped partial signal only. Full physics credit requires solver health except for the exact private oracle proof path.
public_disclosure_alignment_note: The public files include coarse design guidance and public_calibration_samples.json. Hidden case targets remain private; public calibration data provides coarse tradeoff guidance without copying a private oracle point.
case_target_tolerance_note: Physics criteria combine hidden fixed-case anchors with public useful-performance windows. High credit requires hidden-case performance, while public windows provide partial credit for plausible non-oracle designs.
